status: engineering fit study; not a manufacturing release

enclosure.normalization: X=vendor X-body Xmin; Y=body Ymax-vendor Y; Z=base Zmin-vendor Z
enclosure.clear_cover_assumption: The standard cover shape is shown transparent; optical properties are illustrative.

power.datum: 84.65 x 32.8 mm shortened R1 PCB; original connector datum retained; nominal thickness 1.6 mm

meter.datum: Candidate riser plane at base J4; finger insertion depth 8 mm, requires mating-model confirmation

host.datum: Provisional lower-left position derived from user observation: TFT top flush with meter PCB top, with ten-pin row centers aligned. The X/Z offsets are illustrative until the actual connector seating and S3 stack are measured; J1 footprint/model identity remains unresolved.

module.part: LOLIN S3 Mini Pro with integrated TFT
module.coordinates: Host STEP coordinates before the host assembly transform; Z follows actual exported carrier top
module.assumption: Module outline from Wemos; thickness, 2.5 mm seated header gap, TFT/USB envelopes, connector orientation and electrical pin compatibility remain unverified. No separate OLED.

riser_allowance.assumption: Kinematic allowance only, not a validated FR4 strain, solder-joint or socket-retention model.

order: Remove rail clip/base, both terminal guards and cover; unplug field wiring.
Attach the carrier/S3 to the metering board from below; then insert the combined pair into the power PCB PCI socket outside the enclosure.
Tilt and insert the three-PCB set from the open rear with up to 3 degrees of riser allowance; the two Nano-Fit cable plugs are absent.
After the assembly is seated, attach the Nano-Fit cable plugs; wiring and mating access must be checked physically.
Refit guards/base/cover only after connector, cable and latch clearance is verified.
insertion.caution: Full nominal motion is illustrated even after modeled contact. Red intersections with the uncut body are not a collision-free fit claim; actual enclosure cuts are unmeasured.
